newsitem.title: UK: United Utils appoints energy, telecoms head.
newsitem.headline: United Utils appoints energy, telecoms head.

text.p: British multi-utility United Utilities Plc said John Beckitt had been appointed managing director of its energy and telecommunications division, replacing Malcolm Faulkner.
Beckitt, previously managing director of United's process equipment unit, will report to chief executive Brian Staples.
Faulkner stays on as a director of United and chairman of Norweb, its electricity business.
"This management change is an integral part of the group's preparations to successfully enter the competitive energy markets in 1998," Staples said.
